ai_workflow.preamble: This repository is a library of composable AI agent rules for ai-rulesmith. Rules live under src/rules/, profiles under src/profiles/. Install with `task install`, validate with `task validate`, list rules with `task list`, rebuild agent files with `task build`. Rule pages on the docs site come from a symlink to src/rules/; profile pages are built from src/profiles/ at docs build. Do not edit generated agent files by hand. Everyday work: Implement, then Review, then Verify.

steps.description: Add or amend rules, profiles, and handwritten docs. Propose rule text before writing files when the change is a new practice.
Review the change for correctness, clarity, and rule-library constraints before handing it back.
Confirm the library still validates and the docs site still builds. Done when `task validate` and `task docs:build` (or `task ci`) succeed.
